rationale: Objective control is scored in the COMMAND phase of every battle round from 2 onward (11e 25.1), so a marker nobody stands on is free victory points for whoever walks a model within 3 inches of it. Here U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B (OC 3, Move 6) is parked 2.5 inches from obj_nml_1 with no enemy within 30 inches: there is no threat to price, no competing objective in reach, and no reason to be anywhere else. An AI that does not close that 2.5 inches is not weighing a trade-off, it is failing to see the board.
setup: # Put the Custodian Guard within one short move of the uncontested
# no-man's-land objective at (400, 880), and clear the area of enemies so
# the only consideration left is 'take the free points'.
# Park every OTHER friendly far from this objective so the exam measures
# one unit's decision, not the squad-assignment tie-break.

assert.name: Custodian Guard ends movement within control range of obj_nml_1
script: var v = Vector2(float(p.x), float(p.y)) if not (p is Vector2) else p
